items.summary: AAP workers and supporters staged a 'Tiranga Rally' in the national capital today, Oct 16, directing their agitation against the Election Commission over alleged institutional irregularities in the SIR. AAP Delhi chief Saurabh Bharadwaj, holding the national flag, told ANI it was 'sheer madness' to bar Indians from unfurling the Tricolour and said the rally was being held 'right in front of the Rashtrapati Bhavan'. He questioned the massive security deployment ('50,000 security personnel... to stop the Tricolour') and the Central Park closure, rebutted BJP charges that the protests are a conspiracy to incite anarchy, and stressed the rally would be 'completely peaceful - in Mahatma Gandhi's way'. An Indian Express video shows the rally carrying a 200-ft Tiranga. Separately, AAP leader Gopal Rai backed the 'Tiranga Lahra Do' call on X and urged cadres to join the flag movement. No detentions reported from the AAP rally as of report time.
items.title: AAP stages 'Tiranga Rally' near Rashtrapati Bhavan ahead of CJP's 5 PM march
